# PortSwigger

> > PortSwigger provides Burp Suite, the leading web application security testing platform, along with extensive resources for penetration testing and vulnerability research.

PortSwigger is the company behind Burp Suite, offering professional and enterprise security testing tools, a vast library of Burp extensions through the BApp Store, and educational content on web security. Founded by Dafydd Stuttard, PortSwigger serves the global AppSec community with innovative solutions including AI-powered testing capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Burp Suite
- Burp Extensions (BApp Store)
- Web Application Security Testing
- Penetration Testing
- Vulnerability Scanning
- Burp Suite Enterprise Edition
- Burp AI
- HTTP Security
- Active Scanner
- Security Research
- XSS, XXE, SSRF Detection
- JSON and API Testing
- Prototype Pollution
- CSP Bypass
- AppSec Community

## Core Platform

- [Web Application Security, Testing, & Scanning - PortSwigger](https://portswigger.net): PortSwigger homepage featuring Burp Suite and web security tools

## Vulnerability Detection Extensions

- [Server-Side Prototype Pollution Scanner](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/c1d4bd60626d4178a54d36ee802cf7e8): Burp extension by Gareth Heyes detecting server-side prototype pollution
- [Upload Scanner](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/b2244cbb6953442cb3c82fa0a0d908fa): Burp extension testing file uploads for XSS, XXE, SSRF vulnerabilities
- [CSP-Bypass](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/b113bdc1390647b092cb527c0b95116d): Burp extension by Joe DeMesy scanning CSP headers for bypass weaknesses
- [DNS Exfilnspector](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/0e9c1b7acd25422ab1fd1df5d1f09bbd): Burp extension decoding DNS exfiltration via Burp Collaborator for RCE
- [IIS Tilde Enumeration Scanner](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/523ae48da61745aaa520ef689e75033b): Burp extension exploiting IIS Tilde vulnerability for shortname discovery
- [Cypher Injection Scanner](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/72f7b61e22f64ef5882dff6054df5ac7): Burp extension detecting Cypher code injection in Neo4j databases

## AI-Powered & Advanced Testing Tools

- [Shadow Repeater](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/7be1798d600647688bb2f051da37f504): AI-powered Burp extension generating payload variations for testing
- [Turbo Data Miner](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/84350b8f090a4388a9d12cca141f201b): Python-based Burp extension for data extraction and HTTP modification

## Protocol & Format Handlers

- [JSON Escaper](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/5ebb21c4a50a40db9236067e3812fa3f): Burp extension by Akash C for escaping JSON payloads in pentesting
- [gRPC-Web Coder](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/63b92be302fa4521bf18d74b3adbbc00): Burp extension by Amin Nasiri for encoding/decoding gRPC-Web payloads
- [AES Payloads](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/7718318c8ae94d329e8037454585faba): Burp extension by Luis Grangeia for AES encryption/decryption in testing

## Workflow & Utility Extensions

- [Add Custom Header](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/807907f5380c4cb38748ef4fc1d8cdbc): Burp extension by Lorenzo Grespan for custom HTTP headers and JWT support
- [Magic Variables](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/1c19036ead3241b789cc8fcc45387fa7): Burp extension providing dynamic random values and UUID generation
- [Conditional Match and Replace](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/5037418cbd064e439839760567dc12d0): Burp extension by Daniel Jensen for conditional match/replace operations
- [Linebreaker](https://portswigger.net/bappstore/cd13bde2eb2248838432aa36f53c8301): Burp extension by Ads Dawson enabling newline view for readability
